title: 现代数字动漫风格
prompt: Transform this image into a modern digital anime TV style. Use clean and sharp outlines, vivid and high-contrast colors, and digital cel shading with subtle gradients. Add visual effects like glows, particles, or light flares if appropriate. The character design should follow modern anime proportions, with detailed hair and expressive eyes. The background can be softly blurred or cinematic. The image should look like a frame from a high-quality anime series currently airing.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，将图片转换为现代数字动漫风格，拥有清晰轮廓和鲜明色彩，适合动画、游戏角色设计或数字艺术创作。添加微妙的发光效果，打造动态电影感画面。
